name: Macquarie University Student Grant
summary: Non-repayable grant for onshore Macquarie students toward study costs and, in some cases, living expenses.
key: Up to $2,000, or up to $500 for a computer; grants do not need to be repaid.
who: Onshore Macquarie University student; eligibility depends on circumstances
how: Complete the online application, a budget spreadsheet and supporting documents
Contact a Welfare Advisor if unsure
catches: Rent or food considered only in some cases

source.label: Macquarie University: Student loans and grants

evidence.quote: Grants do not need to be repaid.
